David, Lisa, Douglas, and Ali debate whether 'alaq in 96:2 should be translated as 'embryo' or 'clot,' with Khalifa citing Maurice Bucaille to reject 'clot.' Sabahi and Ali reflect on human transgression through wealth (96:6–7) and mandatory versus forbidden prayer, citing experiences in post-revolutionary Iran. Khalifa concludes with administrative updates and leads the recitation of Al-Fatiha.
